title: RCT Novasure Versus Novasure + Mirena IUS in the Treatment of Menorrhagia
brief_summary: Hypothesis. Combined treatment with novasure and mirena IUS confers benefit over Novasure alone in the treatment of menorrhagia
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Anybody suitable for novasure ablation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mirena IUS is indicated as treatment
